articles.title: Justice Department warns California officials about counting some ballots
articles.summary: The Justice Department warned California officials they could face investigation for counting ballots from suspected noncitizens.

articles.title: Strong winds push fast-moving fire into California coastal towns
articles.summary: Wind-driven fires burned homes in Southern California, and about 16,000 people were told to evacuate.

articles.title: Countries fall short on money to protect nature before big U.N. meeting
articles.summary: Countries have raised less than half the money they promised for nature as a U.N. biodiversity meeting begins.
